struct UnionFind {
    vector<int> parent, size;
    int components;
    UnionFind(int n) : parent(n), size(n, 1), components(0) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) parent[i] = i;
    }
    int find(int x) {
        if (parent[x] != x) parent[x] = find(parent[x]);
        return parent[x];
    }
    bool unite(int x, int y) {
        x = find(x);
        y = find(y);
        if (x == y) return false;
        if (size[x] < size[y]) swap(x, y);
        parent[y] = x;
        size[x] += size[y];
        return true;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int p, k;
    cin >> p >> k;

            }
            cc = (int)comps.size();

        for (int i = 0; i < cc; ++i) {

        }

    cout << result << "\n";
